snippet.title: Alliance Tales: Battle for the Frontier - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Alliance Tales is a standalone mission pack set in the Alliance Peacefighter universe. It's a linear, story-driven space combat sim in the style of 90s classics such as Wing Commander and Tie Fighter. Search for a missing friend while foiling a plot to take over the frontier colonies.
